name: sts:AssumeRole scoped by NotResource (broad inverse scope)
note: A NotResource scope on an Allow grants sts:AssumeRole on EVERY role EXCEPT the listed one - an inverted, broad scope that reaches many roles. resourceListIsBroadForAssume treats NotResource as broad, so this must be flagged as ASSUME-ROLE-EXPANSION. Complements the partial-wildcard boundary fixture.
